scope: Cross-check of all 49 segment training modules, their rule catalogs, Section 11 message templates, source anchors, validator/test inventory, and independent Test BR/TS/TC/TD evidence.

sourceAnchorVerification.missingSectionInterpretation: The verifier does exact matching of the complete section string. Many records use valid composite section strings such as 11.4.1.1,12.6 or Chapter/Appendix aliases. The 72 findings are not automatically classified as invalid; each composite/alias needs an explicit resolution or verifier enhancement. Structural check remains true, semantic source verification requires human review.

validatorAndTestInventory.qualification: Generic message-family validators/tests exist for some of these modules (for example Totals, load envelopes, and Communications Test), and Segment 100 has extensive shared/context validation. They do not establish deterministic field-level validation for every listed segment rule.

businessRequirementAndChainEvidence.assessment: BR creation/approval is not complete for all 49 segments. The approved atomic BR artifact is empty. The 314-BR package is draft, covers a denominator of 309 rather than the current 601 catalogued rules, and contains placeholder downstream artifacts. Do not report these records as approved or executable coverage.

verifiedFindings.finding: No approved independent atomic Test Solution BRs exist; the existing draft package has placeholder downstream evidence and is not execution-ready.
Dedicated segment-named field/payload validators and tests exist for only 12 of 41 numeric segment catalogs. Generic transaction/load validators do not prove every segment rule is executable.
Independent BR package denominator and inventory are stale relative to the current catalog: 309/289 rules represented in package/inventory versus 601 currently catalogued rules.

Automated source verifier reports 72 section-presence misses due to exact comparison of composite section labels/aliases. The structural anchor checks pass, but these 72 source links need normalized or manually resolved evidence.

Segment 110 is not a row in the literal Section 11.1.1 Financial request table. It is captured separately as an SME-approved extension from the broader Section 12.9 applicability rule; preserve that distinction.
Known message-table/segment-definition length conflicts are now explicit in template metadata and remain unresolved: Segment 119 389 vs 493, Segment 130 9999 vs 3043, and Segment 131 3850 vs 3834.
SEG105-R-001 through SEG105-R-017 previously used the prose label Totals Request as the source section. Anchors now identify Section 12.6; message-layout rules retain Section 11.4.1.1 anchors.

limitations: This is a repository-evidence audit, not human/SME approval.
Not all 601 rules were individually re-derived against every PDF field/value in this pass; source-anchor structural validation and targeted message/anchor checks were run.
The template catalog remains EXTRACTED and human_review_required.
TransArmor Segment 116 remains blocked on an external specification; CA Public Key File Load request placement remains provisional under SEG132-SME-006.

Bring the 309/289 draft denominators and packages into reconciliation with the current 601-rule catalog inventory.
